This exceptional painted-brick federal residence, circa 1900, seamlessly blends timeless historic character with contemporary design in the heart of Georgetown. Spanning approximately 1,895 square feet, this three-bedroom condo lives like a single-family home and showcases high ceilings, oversized windows with abundant natural light, exposed brick walls, wide-plank oak hardwood flooring, designer lighting, and beautifully curated finishes throughout. Perched high on a quiet, tree-lined cobblestone street, the home offers a rare balance of peaceful residential living while being moments from all conveniences. The open-concept main level features a seamless flow between the living, dining, and kitchen areas—perfect for entertaining! The kitchen is complete with a double waterfall-edge quartz island, high-end Viking and Bosch stainless steel appliances, a six-burner Viking range with pot filler, oversized Viking refrigerator and freezer, Italian white gloss cabinetry, and a spacious pantry with sliding drawers. The main floor also offers a powder room and plenty of nooks for a work-from-home office. On the lower level, you will find the primary suite with an ensuite bathroom that includes dual vanity and a spacious standing shower. Two additional bedrooms with access to the updated hall full bathroom, laundry center, and high ceilings. The small two-unit building was completely restructured in 2016, and additional highlights throughout the home include a built-in dual-zone Sonos audio system, security system, Ring doorbell, and a user-friendly Honeywell thermostat system for the central heating/cooling. The unit includes a private rear parking space accessed from the oversized alley. Outdoor spaces feature professionally landscaped grounds, a covered front porch, rear deck, private lower-level patio, and a storage shed. Perfectly positioned on one of Georgetown's most sought-after streets, 1224 M Street NW is just moments from the acclaimed restaurants, coffee shops, and nightlife along M Street and Wisconsin Avenue. Everyday conveniences including Whole Foods Market and Trader Joe's are both within approximately a 10-minute walk. Low condo fee of $298/month which includes water, sewer, parking, and master insurance. Pet friendly! Next Saturday, May 16th, 1-3pm.

This is a Georgetown inclusionary zoning unit home. You must be approved by DHCD before being able to submit an offer. DHCD will conduct a lottery. There are income restrictions based on household size. This unit is not for rent. Prospective purchasers must submit income information to a DHCD-approved certifying entity to determine whether they are income eligible to purchase the unit in accordance with the terms of the covenant. The certifying entity will review the income of the prospective purchaser to determine their eligibility and confirm that the resale price is affordable to the prospective purchaser. DHCD will review the documentation provided by the certifying entity. Home will be listed in DC Housing Locator.

This exceptional Capitol Hill residence, defined by its dramatic cathedral-ceiling family room and treehouse-like deck overlooking the surrounding canopy, offers a rare combination of scale, flexibility, and walkable urban convenience. Thoughtfully designed for both grand entertaining and comfortable daily living, the home features 5 bedrooms, 3.5 baths, across 5 finished levels of almost 5,000 square feet of beautifully proportioned living space. At the heart of the home, the stunning family room is anchored by custom built-ins, a wet bar, and walls of glass opening to the expansive rear deck, creating a seamless indoor-outdoor living experience. A gracious living room, formal dining room, and spacious eat-in kitchen provide exceptional flow throughout the main level, making the home equally suited for intimate gatherings and large-scale entertaining. The upper level is highlighted by an extraordinary primary suite with dual walk-in closets, an additional storage closet, adjoining office, and spa-inspired bath with a glass-enclosed dual-head shower and jetted tub. Four additional bedrooms provide ample accommodations, while the lower level offers exceptional versatility with an au pair suite, recreation room, exercise room, office, and extensive storage rarely found in Washington homes. Additional highlights include an attached garage with EV charger, private deck with built-in TV, underground sprinkler system, mature landscaping, and a custom birds of paradise mosaic window welcoming guests at the front door. Ideally located just blocks from the Eastern Market, Barracks Row along 8th Street SE, the Capitol dome, and the Library of Congress, the home also benefits from its proximity to Union Station, Lincoln Park, and Stanton Park squares. A rare opportunity to enjoy substantial living space, exceptional entertaining areas, and one of Capitol Hill's most desirable and convenient locations. Please note: square footage is estimated and calculated by an independent third party; information is deemed accurate but not guaranteed.

Georgetown is one of Washington DC's most coveted and quietly distinguished neighborhoods—residential, architecturally rich, and easily accessible to the city's vibrant urban amenities. At the heart of the neighborhood, this classic federal-style rowhouse delivers historic character, sophisticated scale, and thoroughly modern convenience in equal measure. Soaring ceilings, graciously proportioned rooms, and beautiful hardwood floors set the tone from the moment you arrive, while an end-unit position brings in natural light from windows on three sides—a luxury simply unavailable in the interior rowhouses that define much of the city. The south-facing rear amplifies this even further, with a sun-drenched sunroom and composite deck that transform daily living into something that feels genuinely expansive. A screened front porch is an inviting perch for morning coffee or evening conversation year-round. The main level unfolds with ease and grace: a welcoming foyer, a formal living room anchored by a gas fireplace and custom built-ins, a formal dining room sized for effortless entertaining, and a beautifully renovated kitchen with custom cabinetry, granite countertops, and a marble backsplash. The south-facing sunroom—awash in natural light and framed by French doors—works equally well as a den, home office, or sitting room, opening directly to the deck for seamless indoor-outdoor living. Upstairs, the primary suite offers a serene retreat with a dedicated sitting room and fully renovated bathroom, alongside three additional bedrooms, a shared full bath, and a convenient laundry closet. A walk-up attic provides generous storage and a large cedar closet. The lower-level in-law suite—with its own living area, full kitchen, bedroom, renovated bathroom, walk-in closet, independent HVAC, and sound insulation between levels—offers exceptional flexibility for extended family, guests, or rental income to offset carrying costs. A new stone walkway, landscaped yard, and detached two-car garage complete the picture. Georgetown is the rare neighborhood that rewards those who find it—close enough to walk to the shops, restaurants, and energy of M Street and Wisconsin Avenue, and minutes from the C&O Canal towpath and Potomac waterfront, yet quietly removed from the bustle of all of them. Rising above Capitol Hill with sweeping views of the Capitol dome, Library of Congress, Lincoln Park, and Stanton Park squares, Penthouse 08 at Vio represents a truly once-in-a-generation offering. Thoughtfully curated as Vio's premier residence, this extraordinary home combines architectural scale, refined craftsmanship, and unparalleled indoor-outdoor living across two dramatic levels. Designed for both grand-scale entertaining and intimate everyday living, the home seamlessly blends sophisticated interiors with extraordinary outdoor spaces. At the center of the residence is an exceptional private rooftop unlike anything else currently available in Capitol Hill. Complete with expansive covered and uncovered terraces, outdoor dining and lounge areas, a rooftop garden, skylight, fire features, grill, and panoramic views of the historic district, the outdoor experience rivals that of a private luxury resort. Retractable glass walls create a seamless transition between indoors and out, elevating every gathering against one of the most iconic backdrops in Washington. Further enhancing the rarity and convenience of the offering, the residence conveys with three garage parking spaces and three storage spaces, including one exceptionally large storage room rarely found in luxury condominium living. Every element of this residence has been intentionally customized and impeccably maintained, resulting in a home that is both architecturally significant and exceptionally livable.

Attention first-time home buyers! Purchase a $440,000 home with a $375,000 mortgage pre-approval! Housing Initiative Partnership, Inc., a local non-profit housing developer, is offering an incredible opportunity to purchase this new construction, high efficiency net zero home! In order to purchase the home, you must be a first-time home buyer at or below 80% of the median area income and must use the property as your primary residence. Nestled in the historic Georgetown district, this federal-style brick rowhouse offers a charming cobblestone front porch leading to a wide open main living level with abundant natural light. The beautifully appointed kitchen features granite countertops and stainless steel appliances. Upstairs, the light and airy feel continues with a primary suite offering a full primary bathroom and two closets, and two additional spacious and bright bedrooms with a full bathroom. Out back, enjoy a large and fully fenced backyard. The home is super energy efficient, featuring triple pane windows, upgraded insulation, very efficient appliances and systems, and solar panels that will be installed in a few weeks. The sale price is $440,000 but buyers only need to qualify for a $375,000 loan. The non-profit seller, HIP, is offering a 2nd deed of trust for $65,000 with zero interest and zero payments, which is fully forgiven after living in the property for 20 years as your primary residence. What a deal!! HIP encourages the use of Pathway to Purchase and encourages home inspections.

rewrites.rewritten_text: This mid-century modern ranch residence features 3 bedrooms and 3.5 bathrooms. The property is set on 0.35 acres and offers nearly 3,107 square feet of living space. A bonus room provides flexibility for a home office, gym, or guest space. The backyard features a heated swimming pool, a new composite deck, and a waterproof pergola with adjustable louvers. The property also includes a shed for storage. The driveway includes a 30-amp receptacle for an RV. Additional updates include a kitchen remodel, closet cabinetry, spa, pool renovation, driveway expansion, new electrical panels, master bedroom and bath updates, new roof, landscaping, and replacement windows and doors.
